name: Celestial Resort
lead: Celestial Resort is the third chapter of Celeste . Preceded by Old Site and succeeded by Golden Ridge , it occurs in the decrepit Celestial Resort Hotel. It introduces Mr. Oshiro , a ghost who manages the hotel and tries convincing Madeline to stay. This chapter notably features a vast number of Dust Bunnies , which are the products of Mr. Oshiro's insecurities. They serve as the chapter's main obstacles, although spikes still appear.
